content: X is ending its controversial revenue-sharing program for content creators, which has seen numerous revisions under Elon Musk’s reign. In its place, it’s launching a new Original Content Rewards program on September 8th. To be eligible, creators must have at least 500 verified followers and at least 500,000 Home Timeline impressions from verified users in the last 90 days, among other requirements. Creators will then earn revenue based on “qualified impressions” on “original content.”Qualified impressions are unique impressions from Premium subscribers “on the Home Timeline feed, where at least 50% of the post is visible.” What qualifies as “original content” exactly? Well, that’s a little harder to define. Under the guidelines, original reporting or analysis, videos and photos taken by the user, as well as graphics or illustrations made by the creator, including memes. X also says that commentary or reactions still qualify, as long as they “add something meaningful.” In the post announcing the program, the company says the goal is to shift the focus away from exploiting loopholes and clickbait. Simply repurposing content from others or replying to posts wouldn’t be a viable source of income under the new system, theoretically. Allegra Jacchia, Senior Product Manager, Creators at SpaceXAI, said on X that the program was designed to “reward the creators who bring original ideas, expertise, creativity, and unique perspectives to 𝕏 -- not those who have become best at gaming the system.” [Media: https://twitter.com/allegrajacchia/status/2085835677917221171] Participants in the revenue-sharing model will continue to earn revenue through September 7th.
chineseTitle: X 用“原创内容奖励”取代了其收入分享计划
chineseSummary: X 正在结束其备受争议的内容创作者收入分享计划，该计划在埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的统治下进行了多次修改。取而代之的是，它将于 9 月 8 日推出新的原创内容奖励计划。要符合资格，创作者必须拥有至少 500 个经过验证的关注者，并且在 [...] 中经过验证的用户至少有 500,000 个主页时间线印象
chineseContent: X 正在结束其备受争议的内容创作者收入分享计划，该计划在埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的统治下进行了多次修改。取而代之的是，它将于 9 月 8 日推出新的原创内容奖励计划。要符合资格，创作者必须拥有至少 500 名经过验证的关注者，并且过去 90 天内至少有 500,000 次来自经过验证的用户的主页时间线展示以及其他要求。然后，创作者将根据“原始内容”上的“合格印象”获得收入。合格印象是来自高级订阅者“在主页时间轴提要上的独特印象，其中至少有 50% 的帖子可见”。到底什么才算“原创内容”？嗯，这有点难以定义。根据准则，原始报告或分析、用户拍摄的视频和照片，以及创作者制作的图形或插图，包括模因。 X还表示，评论或反应仍然是合格的，只要它们“添加了一些有意义的东西”。该公司在宣布该计划的帖子中表示，其目标是将焦点从利用漏洞和标题诱饵上转移开。理论上，在新系统下，简单地重新利用他人的内容或回复帖子并不是可行的收入来源。 SpaceXAI 创作者高级产品经理 Allegra Jacchia 在 X 上表示，该计划旨在“奖励那些为 𝕏 带来原创想法、专业知识、创造力和独特视角的创作者，而不是那些最擅长玩弄系统的人。” [媒体：https://twitter.com/allegrajacchia/status/2085835677917221171]收入分享模式的参与者将在 9 月 7 日之前继续赚取收入。
